<noinclude>Hand-editable Character sheet schema 1. See [[Help:Contents]] and the tracked <code>docs/CHARACTER_SHEETS.md</code> guide. Generated by <code>ops/build-character-sheet-templates.cjs</code>; do not independently change the two-template contract. Identity: name, server, level, classes, aa, race, updated. Totals use <code>total_</code> plus a lowercase canonical stat key. Equipment uses the fixed slot prefix plus <code>_item</code>, <code>_tier</code>, <code>_icon</code>, <code>_stats</code>, <code>_augment_slots</code> and <code>_augment_1_item</code> through <code>_augment_8_stats</code>. No progress, raw screenshots, private OCR evidence or game artwork is embedded.</noinclude>
